name: Serum Brute

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Blindsight 60 ft. only while its eyes are sealed (blind beyond that radius until Unleashed Eyes).

traits.name: Curse Dependent
traits.summary: If targeted by Remove Curse or similar magic, until a Long Rest it loses Blindsight, Withering Eye and Cursed Gaze.
traits.text: If the brute is targeted by Remove Curse or similar magic, then until it finishes a Long Rest it loses its Blindsight, its Withering Eye trait and its Cursed Gaze action.

traits.name: Stimulant Rush
traits.summary: At the start of its turn it picks one: Catalyst Infusion (Speed 50, no Opportunity Attacks, big jumps), Caustic Secretion (Fists +2d10 Acid) or Stim Boost (10 Temporary Hit Points); never the same twice running.
traits.text: At the start of each of its turns the brute must pick one option, and can't pick the same one two turns in a row. Catalyst Infusion: until its next turn its Speed is 50 feet, it provokes no Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach, and its Long Jump is up to 30 feet and High Jump up to 15 feet, with or without a running start. Caustic Secretion: until its next turn its Fist attack deals an extra 11 (2d10) Acid damage (already counted in the Fist entry). Stim Boost: it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
traits.summary: When Bloodied, its sealed eyes tear open: no longer blind beyond 60 ft, and Withering Eye and Cursed Gaze work until a Long Rest.
traits.text: The first time the brute is Bloodied, its sealed eyes rip open and unleash its curse. It is no longer blind beyond 60 feet, and it can use its Withering Eye trait and Cursed Gaze action until it finishes a Long Rest, when the eyes seal shut again. (In the game this is its phase Unleashed Eyes.)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Fist attacks, and Cursed Gaze when it is unleashed and ready.
actions.text: The brute makes two Fist attacks and can use Cursed Gaze if it is available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.summary: +8, reach 10 ft, 1d8+5 Bludgeoning, plus 2d10 Acid while Caustic Secretion is active.
actions.text: A huge fist: 9 (1d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, plus 11 (2d10) Acid damage if Caustic Secretion is active.

actions.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
actions.summary: Only once its eyes are unleashed. 30-ft cone, DC 16 Wis save: 2d8 Psychic (half on a success) and Frightened until its next turn on a failure.
actions.text: Wisdom save, DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage, and the target is Frightened until the start of the brute's next turn. Success: half damage only.

reactions.name: Devotion
reactions.trigger: An ally within 5 feet takes damage.
reactions.summary: Reaction: an ally within 5 ft resists that damage, and the brute takes Psychic damage equal to what the ally takes.
reactions.text: Trigger: an ally within 5 feet of the brute takes damage. Response: the ally gains Resistance to that damage, and the brute takes Psychic damage equal to the damage the ally takes.

phases.name: Unleashed Eyes
phases.summary: Bloodied: its sealed eyes rip open; it sees past 60 ft, hurts anyone it moves next to, and can use Cursed Gaze.

traits_add.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
traits_add.summary: When it moves within 5 ft of a creature, that creature takes 1d8 Psychic (once per turn).
traits_add.text: When the brute moves to within 5 feet of a creature, that creature takes 4 (1d8) Psychic damage. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

summary: A stitched, drugged giant with its cursed eyes sewn shut: it pounds with long-reach fists, boosts itself with serum each turn, and tears its eyes open when hurt.
